title: watchme-emits-a-probe
intention: A NODE EMITS THE WATCHER THAT MEASURES ITS OWN INTENT. The state `LEARNING` is replaced by the summons `WATCHME`, whose act is to EMIT A PROBE — the immutable worker that gathers data about whether this node's intention actually did what it claimed, in the world, after it rests. Being in the workflow is what obliges the ticket to SPECIFY, at ticketing, everything needed to emit that probe: how it accumulates (the trigger), when it clears (the enough-condition), what rides back (the carrier), where that lands (the nexus), and who consumes it. Default carriage is a verdict artifact written against the ticket's own falsifier — the same schema, validator, deposit door and kick-back routing the build-time verdict already uses — but carriage MAY be something else (a metric accumulating for a consumer orthogonal to this intention) provided the spec names its shape and its consumer. A probe carries NO AUTHORITY: it deposits and it pokes; the back-edge on a failed efficacy verdict is the owner's act (Law 6).
why:
THE FALSIFIER BECOMES EXECUTABLE. Every cast node in this system already carries a falsifier and a horizon — /intent question 5 demands it, /sorted's completeness gate refuses a cast without it, and a PROVED node is described as resting 'still carrying falsifier+horizon'. That field has been PROSE on every ticket since the beginning: written, never fired, never measured. Law 4 says a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy, and until it is it is a tracked debt. This node is the payment. A probe emitted at WATCHME IS the falsifier and horizon written in a form that fires.

WHY THE OLD SHAPE HAS TO GO RATHER THAN BE EXTENDED. `LEARNING` was minted as a terminal state before probes existed as machinery, to stand in for exactly this: a place a node could sit while data about its efficacy accumulated. Probes now exist (cairn/tools/base/probe.py — immutable, trigger-as-open-predicate, carrier-as-open-callable, evaluated where the data is owned). So the state has nothing left to do that the worker does not do better: keeping it would mean the node DWELLS while its watcher runs, which is wrong at the tail — a proved intention's efficacy data can only accumulate AFTER it rests, so a node that waits for it never rests and never gets measured. Emitting instead of becoming lets the node rest at PROVED and the watcher stand. That deletes a state rather than adding one.

WHY LEARNME AS IT STANDS IS THE INVERSION OF THE INTENT. Measured 2026-07-30: code-seam@v1 and skill@v1 both carry LEARNME in `path` with `skippable_summons: ['TICKETME']`, so LEARNME is MANDATORY TO CROSS for every node of both classes — and it carries NO GATE (the build gate fires at PROVEME->forward, the exit gate at ->PROVED). It is the one summons in the path that is forced and unchecked. Akien's rule is the exact inverse: optional to CARRY, mandatory to SATISFY once carried. Under the forced-and-unchecked shape the crossing gets filled with whatever is at hand — on ticket a-node-holds-one-claim (2026-07-29) it was filled with close-bookkeeping (depositing that voyage's own berths), which is not efficacy data at all and involved no accumulation; the node never dwelled. /sail step 8 has quietly redefined LEARNME as 'deposit the learnings at the close', and MAP.md's gloss ('learn *from* me — I am material, harvest me into the trees') reads the node as passive corpus. Akien's reading is active: the node causes learning to occur. Same word, two meanings, and the passive one is what got built.

LEARNING WITHOUT AN OBJECT IS INERT (Akien, 2026-07-30). A bare token in the path cannot state what is being learned, so nothing can check it. The object is forced by structure the way `intention+why.json` forces the why — a WATCHME that cannot name its accumulation is a parse error, not a blank field.

WHY ONE FEEDBACK CONTRACT AND NOT ONE PER THING (Akien: 'We do NOT want to be creating learning contracts for each thing individually'). We already built the general one and had not noticed it was general. cairn/machines/chart/verdict.py carries a schema with teeth (claim / instrument / outcome / evidence per claim; validate_verdict refuses narration, refuses an unattributed verdict, refuses incomplete coverage), a rendering into ANY nexus (verdict_node_parts -> deposit_learning(nexus, content, vector, provenance) — one node per claim, bare, content-hashed), and a return route that is ALREADY PHYSICS (a failed criterion is a kick-back, not a crossing; the exit gate enforces it today). So the standard interface for a question nexus / Stackable Learning Brick is one sentence: it accepts a verdict artifact naming one of its claims, and it emits one. It scales down without a second contract — a thing that is not a whole SLB emits a ONE-CLAIM verdict, and n=1 is not a special case of the schema, the coverage check simply has less to cover.
traces_to: Law 4 — the falsifier is the oldest prose-standing-in-for-physics in the system; this is its enforcement, and CLAUDE.md's rules-awaiting-physics section is supposed to shrink monotonically.
Law 3 — an intention whose efficacy is unmeasured is a hypothesis and must be labeled one. Today every PROVED node is exactly that and nothing says so.
Law 1 — one feedback contract compiled once, not a learning agreement re-derived per component; and the resolver is not spent re-answering 'did that work?' by hand.
Law 6 — a probe is authority-free by construction, which is what lets it stay immutable and shareable; delegated writes go through the owner's gate, never ambiently.

I-learns-its-gates (2026-07-16, founding) — the system learns its gates from evidence. This is that intention at the NODE level; CLAUDE.md's learning-as-a-pattern IOU is the same intention at the COMPONENT level (see distinctions in provenance).

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth beside the code in cairn/tools/base/proofs/ (transitions + probe), extending test_transitions.py and test_probe*.py rather than paralleling them; the chart deposit teeth (cairn/machines/chart/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py) must all still green under the widened validate_ref; sealed under TesterDevice().run_proof(isolation='netns') with the validation persisted beside the code. PLUS the cairnmap recompile gate, twice over: this build edits a model source (intentions-not-beside-code/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md) and edits skills (/sail, /sorted), so cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh is poked in the same act as each write. Feeds back to origin on failure: a red at PROVEME back-edges to BUILDME; a red in the MIGRATION (an at-sea node whose string will not convert) back-edges to TICKETME, because that is a decomposition error not a build error.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: (1) a WATCHME crossing is accepted that emitted no armed probe — the gate must check EMISSION (the probe exists, is armed, and carries its trigger, enough-condition, carrier, nexus and consumer), which is the clause that makes 'not optional once present' physics rather than prose. (2) A probe is armed and never fires, and nothing is loud about it — a watcher emitted into a heartbeat nobody runs learns nothing while LOOKING like learning, which is the silent-failure disease wearing our own badge; an unfired watcher past its horizon must surface at a diagnostic surface (Law 7). (3) A ticket carrying WATCHME casts with any part of the spec absent — unspecifiable is never a silent omission: no conceivable efficacy measure is a RED at /sorted's completeness gate (the falsifier is unwritable, so the node is not ready to cast), and specifiable-but-not-yet DROPS A TICKET and carries the IOU. (4) `LEARNING` or `LEARNME` survives anywhere as a LIVE state after the migration — a grep must find them only in history, superseded records and the migration's own record (records of truth are never edited to hide the old shape, Law 7). (5) A probe moves a node's state directly — that is an ambient authority leak (Law 6) and it must be structurally impossible, not merely avoided. (6) A verdict written by a probe cannot pass validate_verdict, or needs a second schema to do so — one contract or the design failed. (7) A node casts with neither a WATCHME nor a recorded 'no keep-learning step, because X'; silence is not a legal answer. (8) The spec's `nexus` or `consumer` cannot name a target outside the toolchain — see the bootstrap distinction; a design that only works when the watched thing is one of our own devices has solved the wrong problem.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read when: the heartbeat actually fires devices' probes in anger (until then clause (2) is the whole risk surface and this node's watchers are armed into a mechanism whose liveness is itself unmeasured); the FIRST efficacy verdict comes back failed and back-edges a resting node (the return route is the least-exercised half of this design and the only part with no existing physics); the first NON-verdict carriage lands (a metric accumulating for an orthogonal consumer) and shows whether 'name the shape and the consumer' is a sufficient obligation or wants its own schema; and the first ticket that is NOT about building the toolchain carries a WATCHME — that is the measurement that says whether the bootstrap distinction was honored or merely written down.

chart_notes.orient: The primitive is already built and its charter is emphatic about what it is NOT — read cairn/tools/base/probe.py's header before anything else; the anti-reification (no trigger enum, no carrier enum) is a fix already applied once to this exact area after CC turned an open list of examples into a closed typed set. Do not re-commit that. Also read intentions-not-beside-code/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md whole, not just the superseded paragraph.
chart_notes.constrain: OUT unless Akien widens it: building the heartbeat/shim liveness this depends on; changing what a probe IS (the primitive is fixed); the tenure loop; any per-component learning contract (the whole point is that there is one). The rest-state kick-back (piece d) is the piece most likely to want to grow into the escalation ladder — hold it to depositing and poking.
chart_notes.survey: COMPOSE, do not rebuild: verdict.py's validator and parts renderer, deposit_learning's provenance path, probe.py's trigger/carrier machinery, the exit gate's existing fail-is-a-kick-back routing, transitions.py's back-edge handling ('back-edge out of LEARNME: ungated, and owes nothing' — test_transitions.py:747). Measure what is ABSENT before building it; the last stone found its own answer already sitting in a discarded return value.
chart_notes.hypothesize: The sharpest kill condition is falsifier clause (2): if an armed probe cannot be shown to FIRE, this node ships a mechanism that looks like learning and is not — which is worse than the prose it replaces. Cast a piece that measures a real fire end-to-end, and be willing to kill the rest of the voyage on it.
